sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 sectors all-green across all timeframes, anchored by sustained leadership in Technology.

Technology continues to dominate cross-asset strength, holding sustained top-three rankings alongside Communication Services as the market's only all-green sectors. Meanwhile, Energy and Healthcare maintain solid momentum at the top of the board, offsetting softness in lagging cyclical sectors.

Defensive pockets are showing mild short-term rotation as Healthcare and Consumer Defensive posted the only rank improvements over the past five sessions. Conversely, Industrials and Financials faded, while Utilities and Consumer Cyclical sit firmly at the bottom of momentum rankings.

## Strength
- Only 2 of 11 groups are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Technology (momentum 0.950) and Communication Services (momentum 0.650).
- Technology is the sole sector demonstrating sustained strength, holding a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- Momentum leadership is concentrated at the top with Technology (0.950), Energy (0.717), and Healthcare (0.717).

## Movers & Momentum
- Healthcare gained +1 spot over the last 5 sessions to reach rank 4 with a strong 0.717 momentum score.
- Consumer Defensive also advanced +1 spot to rank 6 (momentum 0.383).
- Financials dropped -1 spot to rank 7 (momentum 0.483), and Industrials slipped -1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.500).
- Utilities (0.050) and Consumer Cyclical (0.250, rank 11) remain the steepest momentum laggards.

## Divergences
- Communication Services holds an all-green profile and solid momentum (0.650) despite a low relative rank of 9.
- Energy holds the #1 overall rank with 0.717 momentum, yet fails to join Technology and Communication Services in all-green status.
- Basic Materials maintains a top-tier rank of 3 despite middling momentum of 0.500.

rotation_phase.label: Mid Cycle
rotation_phase.reasoning: Technology is the dominant leader with sustained momentum alongside participation from Basic Materials, which aligns best with mid-cycle characteristics despite mixed late-cycle pressures from Energy.

* Communication Services shows fragile momentum, beating SPY on 4/7 timeframes with an rs_score of 0.50, but collapsing to an rs_confirmed score of just 0.17.
* Healthcare suffers from poor outperformance stability, with its rs_confirmed dropping to 0.11 despite beating SPY on 3/7 timeframes (rs_score 0.33).

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad-market leadership remains narrow with only 6 of 144 groups all-green, heavily tilted toward Tech and Healthcare while commodities and transport suffer sharp short-term rank declines.

Market strength is concentrated in core technology and healthcare niches. Semiconductors (0.927 momentum) and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.923 momentum) anchor the top tier alongside Diagnostics & Research (0.918 momentum), all demonstrating clean positive trends across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames. Sustained performance across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons also bolsters groups like Consumer Electronics, Software - Infrastructure, and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.

Conversely, cyclical and resource groups are fading rapidly over the 5-day window, led downward by Integrated Freight & Logistics (-20 spots to rank 69) and Aluminum (-19 spots to rank 100). Meanwhile, travel and consumer-facing plays are staging swift relief bounces, evidenced by Airlines jumping 18 spots and Lodging gaining 14 spots, even as broader momentum laggards like Mortgage Finance (0.047) and Solar (0.063) stay firmly grounded at the bottom.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Core:** Just 6 of 144 industry groups are positive across all timeframes: Semiconductors (0.93 momentum), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.92), Diagnostics & Research (0.92), Internet Content & Information (0.84), Software - Infrastructure (0.80), and Health Information Services (0.80).
- **Multi-Month Consistency:** Groups maintaining top-36 ranks across 1, 3, and 6 months include Diagnostics & Research, Consumer Electronics, Internet Content & Information, Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Software - Infrastructure, Health Information Services, Insurance - Reinsurance, and Marine Shipping.
- **Top Momentum Anchors:** Hardware and tech supply chains dominate momentum metrics, led by Semiconductors (0.927, rank YTD 7), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.923, rank YTD 3), and Computer Hardware (0.897, rank YTD 1).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid Short-Term Advancers:** Airlines gained 18 spots over 5 sessions (rank 88, momentum 0.57), Lodging jumped 14 spots (rank 55, momentum 0.64), and Internet Content & Information rose 13 spots (rank 52, momentum 0.84).
- **Steep Short-Term Decliners:** Integrated Freight & Logistics fell 20 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.33), Aluminum shed 19 spots to rank 100 (momentum 0.23), and Other Precious Metals & Mining dropped 14 spots to rank 101 (momentum 0.41).
- **Entrenched Momentum Laggards:** Underperformance remains severe in Mortgage Finance (0.047 momentum, rank YTD 142), Solar (0.063, rank YTD 139), and Gambling (0.072, rank YTD 143).

## Divergences
- **Early Fading Warnings:** High-momentum segments losing ground over the last 5 days include Steel (momentum 0.76, rank -4), Financial Conglomerates (momentum 0.76, rank -3), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, rank -7), and Silver (momentum 0.66, rank -4).
- **Emerging Rank Turnarounds:** Improving short-term positioning despite subdued overall momentum appears in Real Estate - Diversified (rank +14, momentum 0.53), Apparel Retail (rank +13, momentum 0.47), and Residential Construction (rank +7, momentum 0.36).
